exports.kmlGuideTitle: How to create the My Maps
exports.kmlGuideStep1: Open Google My Maps with your account and create a new map.
exports.kmlGuideStep2: Click the map title and give it the name of the Mission Day.
exports.kmlGuideStep3: In the layer on the left panel, click Import and upload the .kml file downloaded from here.
exports.kmlGuideStep4: Click Share and turn on link access, so that anyone with the link can view the map but not edit it.
exports.kmlGuideStep5: Copy the link and paste it in Settings, in the Map link field.
exports.importHelp: Import the latest file exported for editing in IITC. Only the portals are taken from the file. Names and descriptions stay as they are here. You will see the changes before anything is saved.

team.title: Organisers of this Mission Day
team.help: People who can open this Mission Day in this tool. Owners can also manage this list and delete things; editors can change everything else. This is not the team written in Settings, which is what the application to Niantic lists.

team.addHelp: Use the email they will sign in with. They receive no message from this tool: send them the address of the admin area, where they sign in with a code that arrives at that email.
team.outsider: You are not on this team, but as instance administrator you can manage it. Add yourself to open the rest of the Mission Day.
